question: What auspicious ritual procedure will be taught for villages and similar sites?
premises: The speaker undertakes to declare a procedure.
The procedure concerns the establishment of a peg.
This establishment brings auspiciousness to villages and similar sites.
inference: The auspicious establishment of the peg for villages and similar sites will now be taught.
plain_english: I shall declare the establishment of the peg for villages and the like, which brings auspiciousness.
